newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank names 10 local bond dealers.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank names 10 local bond dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday named five Thai banks, three foreign banks and two local finance firms as its bond dealers to help the central bank run its open market operation in managing short-term liquidity.

A central bank statement said the appointed bond dealers included Bangkok Bank Plc, Krung Thai Bank Plc, Thai Farmers Bank Plc, Siam Commercial Bank Plc, Bank of Asia Plc, Citibank NA, Standard Chartered Bank, Bank of America, Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc, and Phatra Thanakit Plc.
The Bank of Thailand has held weekly auctions of one to three-month central bank bonds in the past year, using them as an instrument for managing liquidity in the Thai money market.

The statement said bond trading with the 10 appointed dealers would improve the central bank's existing bond repurchase and short-term loan window used by the authorities for stabilising domestic liquidity.
